name: bracemark-share
description: The native halves the bracemark-expo share sheet needs, one per host (docs/share-sheet.md). Android: the translucent ShareActivity hosting the RN share sheet, plus the BracemarkShare close() module. iOS: the share extension's view controller (ios-extension/, compiled into the extension target only, never into this pod) and, in the pod, BracemarkShare close() — the same module name as Android — plus ShareExtensionHost, the seam through which the pod's modules reach that controller. Also iOS: BracemarkShareKeyboard, a module that reports how much of the share sheet's frame (a plain View it is handed by tag) the keyboard covers inside the share extension, where RN's own keyboard frames come through RCTKeyWindow() as zero and an iPad's form sheet moves without JS seeing it — a module and not a native view, because the share extension cannot afford an Expo native view's memory. Also iOS: BracemarkShareMemory, which logs the share extension's footprint and headroom per screen. Also iOS: BracemarkShareSwipeGuard, which asks the share extension's view controller to hold the host sheet's swipe-to-dismiss off while the list and tag pickers are up. Local Expo module, autolinked from apps/bracemark-expo/modules into both the app and the extension target; the target itself is created by plugins/with-share-extension.
